name: skill-creator
title_zh: 从零捏一个会自我迭代的 Agent Skill
tagline_zh: 写新技能、改旧技能、跑评测、看方差、调描述触发率——一套流程管到底。不用再在文档和调试器之间来回横跳。
tagline_en: Create, edit, eval, variance-check, and tune trigger descriptions in one flow. No more hopping between docs and.
desc_en: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
why_zh: 它把技能开发闭环焊在一起：改完描述立刻跑评测看方差，能量化改动带来的触发率变化，而不是靠感觉调参。
why_en: It welds the dev loop shut: edit a description, run evals, see variance—quantify trigger-rate shifts instead of tuning by gut.
limit_zh: 只认 AgentOrchestra v0.2.0 的 skill 格式与评测脚本；不接其他框架的 manifest。
limit_en: Only for AgentOrchestra v0.2.0 skill format & eval scripts. No other framework manifests, no standalone plugin bundles. Output ends at a runnable.
title_en: Forge an Agent Skill that iterates on itself
